evidence: Rice bran is the outer layer removed during milling; composition varies with variety, milling/polishing and storage.
why_it_matters: The AI must not treat every bran batch as identical.
intervention_or_measurement: Collect mill, variety if known, date, storage history, supplier specification and lot ID.

evidence: Rice bran contains protein, but values depend on source and analytical basis; use published values only for initial screening.
why_it_matters: Total protein is not the same as extractable protein, recovery or protein-isolate purity.
intervention_or_measurement: Measure protein in the actual lot; record method and wet/dry basis. Measure recovery separately in trials.

evidence: Endogenous lipase hydrolyses triacylglycerols into free fatty acids and glycerol; hydrolytic rancidity is a major barrier to rice-bran food use.
why_it_matters: Can produce rancid/soapy notes and reduce storage stability.
intervention_or_measurement: Test free fatty acids/acid value and storage history; stabilize fresh bran promptly with a validated process.

evidence: Lipase and lipoxygenase, along with moisture, storage and other factors, contribute to rice-bran rancidity.
why_it_matters: Oxidation may create off-flavours even if the protein content looks attractive.
intervention_or_measurement: Assess odour/sensory, oxidation indicators such as peroxide value where appropriate, and shelf-life.

evidence: Phytate is discussed in rice-bran nutrition and stabilization literature; amount and relevance vary with material and processing.
why_it_matters: Can bind minerals; should not automatically be assumed to be the cause of bitter/beany taste.
intervention_or_measurement: If relevant, measure phytate and trial phytase or controlled fermentation; compare before/after and test protein functionality.

evidence: Rice bran contains phenolic compounds, including ferulic acid; compounds may have beneficial bioactivity and can interact with proteins.
why_it_matters: May affect colour/astringency or protein interactions, but not all phenolics are undesirable.
intervention_or_measurement: Use sensory testing and, if justified, a phenolic assay; trial a mild treatment only if it targets a demonstrated problem.

evidence: Rancid, bitter, astringent or beany notes may have different causes; they should not be attributed to one compound without diagnosis.
why_it_matters: Treating the wrong cause may waste protein, water, energy and money.
intervention_or_measurement: Combine sensory panel with FFA/acid value, oxidation indicators, phytate/phenolic tests where relevant and process history.

evidence: Protein solubility and functionality depend on processing conditions; heat and pH may alter structure and performance.
why_it_matters: A high-protein ingredient may not perform in a beverage, emulsion, bakery product or meat analogue.
intervention_or_measurement: Test solubility at target pH, water/oil binding, emulsification, foaming or gelation for the intended application.

evidence: Moisture and water activity are different measurements; bran stability depends on handling, stabilization, packaging and storage.
why_it_matters: Important for microbial stability, enzyme activity and shelf life.
intervention_or_measurement: Measure moisture and aw separately; validate target moisture, packaging and shelf life for the product.

parameter: Food route A: stabilized bran ingredient
evidence: Stabilization is a prerequisite for high-value rice-bran utilization because rapid deterioration restricts food use.
why_it_matters: Lower-complexity route than isolate extraction, but may retain flavour, fibre and fat constraints.
intervention_or_measurement: Prompt collection > validated stabilization > cooling > milling/sieving > barrier packaging > shelf-life study.

evidence: Rice-bran protein extraction and functionality are research topics; the best method depends on target purity and functionality.
why_it_matters: May raise protein concentration but can add processing cost, water use, protein losses and effluent.
intervention_or_measurement: Characterize > stabilize if needed > optional defatting > extraction/fractionation > solid-liquid separation > recovery > drying; set parameters from a specific study.

evidence: A nutritious composition does not establish safety. Risk depends on source, storage, process and final category.
why_it_matters: Unsafe or untraceable lots must not be converted into food by an AI recommendation.
intervention_or_measurement: Supplier traceability; inspect condition; risk-based microbiology, mycotoxin, pesticide and heavy-metal testing according to current applicable rules.

evidence: FSSAI says foods/ingredients lacking standardization under existing regulations may require prior approval under the Non-Specified Food and Food Ingredients Regulations, 2017.
why_it_matters: Rice-bran protein concentrate cannot be assumed approved for every use just because rice bran is a familiar food material.
intervention_or_measurement: Check exact ingredient, intended use, food category, standards, additives, contaminants, label, packaging and approval status.
